about: Trigger-accuracy corpus for the ciso plugin's model-invocable skills (init, hitrust). See RUNBOOK.md for how to run it. hitrust-controls-compiler is intentionally absent: it is disable-model-invocation (maintainer-only, explicit /ciso:hitrust-controls-compiler), so it must never be auto-selected -- queries about its job appear here as negatives (expected: null).
